A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''guard''' of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] was wounded during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. He led ten [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] [[Capture of Theed/Legends|against]] a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]], but his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]], and he suffered an injury to his [[Limb/Legends|leg]]. He found cover nearby and was discovered by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi brought [[Water/Legends|water]] to the [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|guard]], and in return he told Kenobi how to move past the [[Tank/Legends|tank]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|&lt;Sigh&gt; Thank you. You've saved my life.''"<br />"''Is there a way past the tank?''"<br />"''Yeah, the controls to the gate are behind the tank.|The guard, after Kenobi brought him water|<ref name="SWE1 game" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] participated in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SWE1 game" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">The game itself refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> He led ten [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] against an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] after the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]],<ref name="SWE1 game" /> a greedy [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-spanning]] corporation and the instigator of the invasion,<ref name="SWE1 opening crawl">{{Film|I}} [[opening crawl]]</ref> [[Capture of Theed/Legends|entered]] the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. His [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Tank/Legends|tank]], and his [[Limb/Legends|leg]] was broken. He managed to find cover nearby but became stuck there.<ref name="SWE1 game" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met the guard when he was escorting [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]], a [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]] posing as the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], through Theed. Kenobi spoke to the guard, who asked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for [[Water/Legends|water]]. Kenobi brought the guard a [[Canteen/Legends|canteen]] of water, and the guard gave him information about getting past the tank.<ref name="SWE1 game" />
{{Endgame}}

Kenobi was able to circumvent the Armored Assault Tank and continue leading the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] back to the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]].<ref name="SWE1 game" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|That tank took out ten of my troops. There's no way you're going to beat it.|The guard, to Kenobi|<ref name="SWE1 game" />}}
The guard had light skin and wore the standard [[Color/Legends|red]] uniform of the Palace Guards. After being wounded, he did not think he could last much longer when he met Kenobi. When Kenobi brought the guard a canteen of water, he showed gratitude. The guard also did not think the Jedi would be able to beat the Armored Assault Tank, which took out his troops.<ref name="SWE1 game" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Never mind.|What the player may say to ignore the guard|<ref name="SWE1 game" />}}
The guard appears in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] adaptation of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars:'' Episode I'' The Phantom Menace'']] film. The player, taking the role of Kenobi, may meet this guard during the course of the game's fifth mission. The player can talk to the guard using several dialogue options, and may choose to ignore the guard or bring him water. If the player chooses the latter option, the player finds a nearby pool of water and brings the canteen back to the guard, who gives information to the player about the nearby tank. This article assumes this [[canon]]ical path. The [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] explains how to complete this side-quest. In the game's credits, [[Nick Jameson]] is listed as voicing "Injured Soldier #2," while [[Greg Burson]] is listed as voicing "Injured Soldier #1," although it is not clear who voices this individual character.<ref name="SWE1 game" />
